_doc: Per-issue manual-X overrides. Keys are issue IDs. 'closer' replaces the auto view-card line on the final (link) post. 'hook' (optional) replaces post 1 text. Anything omitted falls back to the published cards. Keep overrides accurate to the verified issue — never sharper than the cards.

2001.closer: You can't cut salaries. You can't cut emergency care. So where does a RM3 billion health cut actually go? Medicine, cleaning, machines... Be honest about it.

1997.hook: Malaysia will split the Attorney-General and Public Prosecutor for the first time since 1957. The 2018 manifesto promised it 'immediately'. Eight years and four AGs later, splitting the office is the easy part. Who confirms the new prosecutor is not.
